title: Constructor Research
no_org: Choose an organization to see its Research projects.
no_backend: This Studio has no environments service, so nothing runs in Research from here.
about: {org} builds its products in Constructor Research and runs each as one of its applications, on the hardware Research gives and at the address Research opens. Every member builds and deploys with their own Research sign-in.
steps_label: From a specification to a product running in Research
step_deploy: Build and deploy from a project's Releases
sign_in_why: Your own sign-in: Studio never builds or deploys with somebody else's.
connect_why: A Research project you own or collaborate on becomes an environment, with the hardware its services run on.
connect_admin: An administrator of the organization connects one.
deploy_how: In a project's Releases, Build in the Research environment: Studio prepares the product and Research builds its images. Then Deploy: the product becomes one application, named after the project and the environment. Roll back deploys an earlier build again; Uninstall removes the application.
no_projects: No Research project is connected yet.
infrastructure_hint: Research projects are places among the organization's clusters and registries too.
hardware_default: the smallest hardware without a GPU
